messages:
maya: Quick sync  we need to finalize DP 'opportunity sculpt' process before sprint planning. Recruiting target: 8 partners, two 2-week pilots, clear go/no-go metrics.

anton: OK. Question: any overlap risk with the private beta? We should mark a no-double-invite list.

linh: +1 on the overlap guardrail. Proposal: 30m scoping workshop per partner to capture must-haves vs nice-to-haves. Reuse my scoping template: https://tiny.redwood/scoping-template

ravi: Blocking items to flag now: NDA routing and any KMS/HSM approval paths. Those HSM reviews could add ~2 weeks to timeline if needed.

maya: Draft acceptance checklist:
```
- SDK integration + sample app deployed
- 2 partner user flows exercised end-to-end
- Quality regression <= 2% on core prompts (baseline eval)
- Weekly synth-evals shared; triage tickets created in <48h
- Partner commit: ~16 engineering hours/week during pilot
```
Agree?

samir: Two infra items: guarantee a demo throughput window (we suggest 200 rps burst) and define a fallback route. If Dedicated capacity isn't available, auto-route to a compatible smaller model and surface a 'degraded performance' flag to partner.

anton: For prioritizing partner asks during pilot: simple scorecard = Impact * Urgency * Feasibility (1-5 each). I'll build a sheet and share.

linh: Draft recruiting DM (short):
"Hey — Redwood running a 2-week inference pilot. We'll provide capacity + eng support. Looking for teams that: 1) have a live flow to test, 2) can commit ~8-12 hrs/week, 3) can join weekly feedback sessions. Interested?"

ravi: @maya please loop legal on the HSM/KMS requirement. We'll need a one-page SOW addendum for partners requiring HSM access.

maya: Owners: anton -> outreach + scorecard, samir -> infra SLAs + fallback policy, linh -> scoping workshop + ops runbook, ravi -> legal/SOW. Milestones: outreach & SOW draft by Tue EOD, scoping workshops within 5 business days, first cohort onboarded by month-end.

ops-bot: Calendar: provisional event 'DP Scoping Workshops' created for next Wed 10:0012:00. Invites sent to owners.

ravi: Starting SOW draft and pinging security for HSM checklist.

maya: I'll collate outreach copy + acceptance checklist into one doc tomorrow. Target to have partner signoffs and countersigned SOWs by Friday. :rocket:
